result.topic_en: A list of basic formulas of plane trigonometry for solving triangles (law of sines, law of cosines, half-angle formulas, etc.).
result.transcription:
Praecepta trigonometrica

Trigonometria plana

(1) $a\sin B = b\sin A$.
(2) $aa = bb + cc - 2bc\cos A$
(3) $\mathrm{cotg}\, A = \frac{b}{a\sin C} - \mathrm{cotg}.\, C$
(4) $\mathrm{tang}(A + \frac{1}{2}C) = \frac{b+a}{b-a}\,\mathrm{tang}\,\frac{1}{2}C$
(5) $\sin\frac{1}{2}A = \sqrt{\frac{a+b-c\,.\,a-b+c}{4bc}}$
(6) $\cos\frac{1}{2}A = \sqrt{\frac{b+c+a\,.\,b+c-a}{4bc}}$
(7.) $\sin A = \sqrt{\frac{a+b+c\,.\,a+b-c\,.\,a-b+c\,.\,b+c-a}{4bbcc}}$
(8) $a = c\cos B + \sqrt{(bb - cc\sin B^2)}$
(9) $\sin(A+C) = \frac{b\sin C}{c}$
